observations: Three photos show a black gaming desktop PC tower with RGB lighting on the front panel.
The front panel has a shield-shaped logo with a red dragon or similar creature, illuminated in red, green, blue, and multicolor across the photos.
The case design is angular and aggressive, typical of gaming PCs.
The photos are taken in a retail environment with shelves of laptops or tablets in the background, lit with strip lighting.
No internal components are visible; no open side panel or interior shots are provided.
No labels, stickers, or visible branding on the case indicate manufacturer or model.
The seller's text claims Intel Core i5 7th gen, 16GB RAM, 256GB SSD + 1TB HDD, and 8GB dedicated RX 480 GPU.
No photos of the motherboard, RAM, storage, or GPU are included.

risks.risk: The system may be non-functional or have hidden damage (e.g., power supply, cooling, or motherboard issues).

Close-up of the CPU socket or motherboard label to confirm CPU generation.
Close-up of the GPU with visible model name (e.g., RX 480).
Video of the system powering on and booting into an OS or BIOS.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a gaming desktop PC, but no internal components are visible to verify the seller's claims.
